name: Moli
description: Fetches, extracts, and automates web pages in an open-source Rust headless browser that outputs Markdown or semantic trees and serves CDP and WebDriver, for agents reading the web.

skills.name: Page Extraction
skills.description: Renders a page as HTML, Markdown, JSON, or a compact semantic tree with moli fetch.

skills.name: Screenshots and PDF
skills.description: Writes viewport or full-page PNGs and paginated PDFs when on-demand layout is enabled.

skills.name: Scripted Interaction
skills.description: Runs a JavaScript expression with --eval before exporting the resulting page.

skills.name: Automation Server
skills.description: Serves CDP, WebDriver Classic, and WebDriver BiDi from one endpoint with moli serve, usable from Playwright.

skills.name: Operational Controls
skills.description: Configures profiles, cookies, proxies, resource policies, timeouts, and private-network policy.
